He folded it into his coat, near his heart, and climbed the long stair to light the lamp.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市沉在浓稠的黑暗里，只有路灯还醒着，橘黄的光晕落在无人的街口。写字楼的灯稀稀落落，像未眠者的眼睛。环卫工人的扫帚声由远及近，划破寂静；出租车缓缓驶过高架桥，车灯拖出一道流动的光。早餐铺的蒸笼腾起第一缕白雾，豆浆的香气悄悄漫过街角。远处，天色由墨蓝转成鱼肚白，城市翻了个身，即将醒来。", "w03": "• A recursive story is like a Russian nesting doll: to open the whole thing, you open one doll, find a smaller one inside, and do the same again.\n• Each step repeats the same little move on a smaller piece, until you reach the tiniest doll that doesn't open — that stopping point is called the base case.\n• Then you close the dolls back up in reverse order, and all those small steps stack together into the finished answer."}
